def transform(g):
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    out=[r[:] for r in g]
    # find 2x2 blocks (topleft)
    tls=[(i,j) for i in range(h-1) for j in range(w-1)
         if g[i][j]==2 and g[i][j+1]==2 and g[i+1][j]==2 and g[i+1][j+1]==2
         and (i==0 or g[i-1][j]!=2 and g[i-1][j+1]!=2)
         and (j==0 or g[i][j-1]!=2 and g[i+1][j-1]!=2)
         and (i+2>=h or g[i+2][j]!=2 and g[i+2][j+1]!=2)
         and (j+2>=w or g[i][j+2]!=2 and g[i+1][j+2]!=2)]
    hit=set()
    for (r,c) in tls:
        # shots: right, down, down-right, down-left
        starts=[]
        for jj in (c+2,):  # right from both rows
            starts.append(((r,jj),(0,1))); starts.append(((r+1,jj),(0,1)))
        for ii in (r+2,):
            starts.append(((ii,c),(1,0))); starts.append(((ii,c+1),(1,0)))
        starts.append(((r+2,c+2),(1,1)))
        starts.append(((r+2,c+1),(1,-1))); starts.append(((r+1,c+2),(1,-1)))
        for (a,b),(di,dj) in starts:
            i,j=a,b
            while 0<=i<h and 0<=j<w and g[i][j]==0:
                i+=di; j+=dj
            if 0<=i<h and 0<=j<w and g[i][j]==2:

        out[r][c]=out[r][c+1]=out[r+1][c]=out[r+1][c+1]=8
    return out
